file_server.description: SSH connection details for the file server hosting the source file. Password should be passed as a resolved gateway-secret reference, not a literal value.

device.description: SSH/SCP connection details for the destination network device. Password should be passed as a resolved gateway-secret reference, not a literal value.

src.description: Absolute path to the source file on the file server.

dest.description: Destination path on the device (e.g. flash:image.bin).
